player_prompt.intro:
Uyimdlali {player_id} kwi Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Kumzuzu wakho, uyakwazi ukuthabatha 'X' noma 'O' kwi skweya elipheleleyo.
Udibana ngokuphakama kwethu thathu zisithethele (X noma O) zisemanzini.
Udibana ngokuthathe isithombe esisodwa.
Khetha imovo yakho ngokusebenzisa ifomati '[X 4]' ukuthabatha X kwisephu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomati yemovo engalungi. Sebenzisa '[X 4]' noma '[O 2]' ifomati.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Inombolo yeseli engekho semthethweni: {cell}. Kufuneka ibe phakathi ko-0 no-8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Ukutshintsha okungavumelekanga. Iseli {cell} sele ihlala umntu omnye.

game_action.placed: Mdlali {player_id} wathabatha isithombe sakhe ({mark}) kwi selu {cell}
